title: Functions: Notation, Domain, Range and Graphs | Algebra I, Unit 4 (with Worked Examples)
description:
What makes a relation a function, the vertical line test, function notation, domain and range, reading intercepts and maximums from a graph, and arithmetic sequences as linear functions. After every lesson there's a step-by-step worked example with tips and a practice question, and the unit ends with a real-world "Putting it together" problem.
